manuscript_claim: Token consumption and provider cost do not by themselves identify incremental organizational value.
allowed_wording: Usage records are inputs to cost attribution, not proof of causal value.

manuscript_claim: The broad enterprise-tokenomics and closed-loop ROI framing overlaps existing scholarly and practice work.
allowed_wording: The contribution is narrowed to an outcome-evidence and decision-accountability bridge.
prohibited_wording: First enterprise tokenomics or first AI ROI framework.

manuscript_claim: The calibration comprised 48 deliberately constructed cases across six domains and eight design strata per domain.
allowed_wording: A 48-case constructed calibration evaluated policy behavior.

manuscript_claim: Two blinded synthetic reviewers passed the revised construct package with no blocking leakage finding.
allowed_wording: Synthetic AI-AI construct stress testing found no blocking issue after packaging revision.

manuscript_claim: The calibration package was hashed and tested before the one-time policy execution.
allowed_wording: All registered pre-execution hashes and tests passed.

manuscript_claim: OVAR false-positive ROI was 2/35 and false-scale was 0/35 on the constructed calibration.
allowed_wording: OVAR produced 5.7% false-positive ROI and no false-scale decisions on the constructed set.

manuscript_claim: OVAR produced two false stops among 13 safe reference cases and two authorization-related harmful actions among 48 cases.
allowed_wording: OVAR false-stop was 15.4%, with two authorization violations.

manuscript_claim: Outcome-flat had lower weighted loss and lower measurement burden than OVAR at every registered burden weight.
allowed_wording: Outcome-flat strictly dominated OVAR throughout the registered burden sensitivity range.

manuscript_claim: OVAR passed five of nine mandatory prospective criteria; the gate stopped v1 and did not authorize held-out construction.
allowed_wording: The prespecified OVAR v1 calibration hypothesis was not supported.

manuscript_claim: The binding errors arose from lexical treatment of temporal expiry and mixed authorization scope.
allowed_wording: The frozen text heuristic missed expiry dates and overgeneralized out-of-scope clauses.
prohibited_wording: All authorization errors in operational systems arise from lexical parsing.

manuscript_claim: The results are calibration behavior on constructed cases, not field effectiveness or realized ROI.
prohibited_wording: Production-ready, causal, deployable, or generalizable effectiveness.

manuscript_claim: A future OVAR version requires structured temporal and scoped authorization records and new preregistered cases.
allowed_wording: Structured authorization is a design implication requiring prospective testing.
prohibited_wording: Structured authorization is already proven to solve the problem.
